en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own numbers and get the same buy-or-keep-renting check before you commit
en.runTitle: Taipei couple on NT$145,000 a month: buy in New Taipei in 2027, or keep renting?

fields.label: Amount you can save each month

en.template: Help me decide whether to buy a first home in {city}. We earn {income}, pay {rent} and have {savings}. Our marriage registration date is {marriage} and we have {kids} minor children. Compare buying at {price} under the 青安3.0 youth loan with continuing to rent, rebuild the cash-needed table, the monthly payments and the 10-year buy-versus-rent comparison with my numbers, keep a {reserve} reserve outside the budget, and tell me how long it would take to save the gap at {saving}.

phases.title: Read the official youth-loan, tax and central-bank pages
phases.note: Loan rules, credit controls, rate sources
phases.judgment: It corrected the question’s premise: the youth-loan programme the couple asked about (“新青安”) ended on 31 July 2026. Its replacement, 青安3.0, takes applications from 1 August 2026 to 31 July 2029.

phases.title: Research purchase taxes, holding costs, bank practice and registered sale prices, then build the guide and break-even tables
phases.note: Taxes and fees, registered prices and rents, loan and cash-needed tables
phases.judgment: It refused to treat re-dated or media-only claims as facts: three government press releases stamped with a 2026 date turned out to be old 2021–22 text, so their numbers were not used, and talk of banks queuing to disburse youth loans rests on one media report and is labelled unconfirmed.

phases.title: Independent recomputation of every money figure, then fixes
phases.judgment: The reviewer reproduced every table figure but found three errors in the advice text, and they were fixed. One example: waiting for a NT$16M home at the assumed saving rate would run to about August 2029, after the 31 July 2029 application deadline, so “waiting costs no eligibility” was wrong.

workers: Read the tax laws and tax-office pages for purchase taxes, fees and yearly holding costs, and estimated the building’s taxable value
Checked the youth-loan rules, bank lending practice, central-bank credit controls, registered sale prices and rents
Recomputed every money figure from the sources and checked the guide’s claims against them, without having written the guide
